articles.summary: The administration seems intent on stripping the congresswoman of her US citizenship and deporting her. It’s a terrible abuse of power What do you think it is about Ilhan Omar, exactly, that seems to get under Donald Trump’s tangerine-tinted skin? The president has claimed he has a problem with the progressive Democratic congresswoman because she is “unpatriotic” to the US and “disrespectful … to Israel”. However, the extent of his animus towards Omar, the first Somali American in Congress, suggests there’s more to it. Trump has insisted he is “the least racist person there is anywhere in the world”, so I’m sure it has nothing to do with the fact that she’s brown and Muslim. Truly, it’s a mystery. articles.title: Paris Bans Protests in Some High-Profile Areas on Thursday
articles.author: Alan Katz and Alessandra Migliaccio
articles.summary: Paris police banned protests and demonstrations Thursday in some areas of the city, including around the presidential palace, along the Champs-Elysées and near other tourist sites, citing the risk of violence.
